alignments.note: χάρις → thanks, the subject of the verbless clause. The supplied copula is not folded here: rule 63 confines rule 53's subject-carrier exception to a subject pronoun, and χάρις is a lexical noun, so the copula is the predicate's helper even against the ASV's word order, which writes thanks be together. Rule 56 does not reach this clause either, rule 62 reading it as giving the supplied verb to the subject only where the subject is the sole token left to carry it, and τῷ θεῷ stands. Reading the dative as a benefactive adjunct rather than a predicate, so that the clause has no predicate at all and thanks be forms one unit, remains defensible; that was the accepted reading and it is the one this correction departs from.
Postpositive δέ realized by the clause-initial But (rule 15).
The ASV gives God no determiner, so the article anchors nothing and is its own unit; the case preposition to therefore stays with the noun under rule 21's determinerless clause (rules 21, 23).

The dative is the predicate of the verbless clause and carries the supplied copula be along with its case preposition to, the subject χάρις being a lexical noun (rules 53, 63). 2CO.5.13's θεῷ → it is unto God is the shape to hold in mind, the noun taking the case preposition because no article stands with a determiner to anchor it (rules 21, 96). Headed on God, the word realizing the lexeme (rule 17).
Reported speech with an expressed complementizer (rule 43).
Imperfect copula with its subject; head on were (rule 9).
Predicate noun; the ASV's gloss note gives bondservants.
No determiner on sin, so the article anchors nothing (rules 21, 23).
Genitive noun with its case preposition of (rule 21).
ὑπακούω rendered became obedient; head on the meaning-bearing obedient, became being the light verb (rules 17, 91). The corpus spends obey and obedient on this root, never became.

The second δέ is realized by whereas. The ASV does not italicize that word, and it carries exactly the contrast δέ marks, the translators subordinating the first clause instead of coordinating the second; the ASV's own margin, Or, that ye were . . . but ye became, shows the connective is what the word renders. Displacement to the head of the preceding clause is rule 15. Leaving δέ unrepresented and marking whereas added under rules 5 and 86 remains defensible and was the accepted reading, but rule 86's test is whether a source token licenses the word, and an otherwise unrealized conjunction standing in the sentence is such a token.
Anarthrous noun with its supplied determiner as a rule 7 helper, no article competing (rules 51, 58).
Preposition rendered to before the noun phrase it governs.

The relative fused with the repeated preposition into whereunto: the where- answers to ὅν and the repeated -unto is a rule 7 helper on the member it introduces under rule 103's function-word arm rather than added (rule 35).
Aorist passive with subject and auxiliary; head on delivered (rule 9).
Anarthrous noun with the supplied demonstrative determiner as its helper, no article competing (rule 60).
Genitive noun with its case preposition of (rule 21).

review_notes: Two corrections. First, the supplied copula be moves from the subject χάρις to the predicate dative θεῷ: rule 63 confines rule 53's subject-carrier exception to a subject pronoun, and rule 62 reads rule 56 as reaching only a clause where the subject is the sole token left to carry the supplied verb, which τῷ θεῷ prevents here. The accepted note's ground — that nothing else stood in the clause — was not available.

Second, the second δέ is aligned to whereas and the added unit is dropped. The word is not italicized, it carries the contrast δέ marks, and the ASV margin (Or, that ye were . . . but ye became) shows the connective is what it renders; rule 86 makes a conjunction standing in the sentence a licensing token.
εἰς is realized twice in English, as to before the noun phrase and as the -unto of whereunto; the repetition is a rule 7 helper under rule 103's function-word arm rather than added.
All 18 source and 27 target IDs are partitioned exactly once in the corrected array.
